subject: Request: temporary invoice-only onboarding for NimbleForge pilot
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@nimbleforge.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcurementOps <procurement@nimbleforge.io>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:15:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at NimbleForge is excited to start the two-week integration pilot. We have a couple of constraints on our side that make a Purchase Order route difficult for a short pilot: our procurement requires a PO only for contracts > $10k, and the initial estimate for this pilot is ~ $3k.

Would Redwood consider an invoice-only onboarding for the pilot (we can sign the attached MOU and provide payment details)? If you need additional evidence for vendor onboarding we can share our company registry, W-9 and insurance summary (I attached a short evidence pack).

Happy to schedule a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Operations
NimbleForge
Attachments: nimbleforge-evidence-pack.pdf, nimbleforge-signed-mou.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@nimbleforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the MOU and evidence pack. Looping in Marissa (Procurement) and Karthik (Legal/Finance review) so we can route this properly.

Quick notes on our side:
- For short pilots we sometimes allow an invoice-only path if evidence and payment terms are clear and the risk tier is low.
- We need the evidence pack to include a W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent tax/registration docs for other regions, and a primary invoice contact.
- If Procurement approves, we'll set a temporary onboarding flag that bypasses PO enforcement for 30 days. Any extension requires either a PO or a contract amendment.

Marissa/Karthik — can you advise on what additional supporting documents you need and whether a 30-day temporary invoice-only flag is acceptable? Elena has attached the two files above.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@nimbleforge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Hi all — reviewed the evidence pack and MOU. Overall looks straightforward, thank you Elena. I have a few process asks before Procurement can sign off on a temporary invoice-only path:

1) Evidence checklist completion: W-9, proof of incorporation, primary invoice email, AP remit details, and proof of commercial liability insurance (minimum $1M). The attached pack had incorporation and MOU but the W-9 is missing — Elena, can you send that?

2) Risk tier & limits: For invoice-only we cap initial pilot exposure at $5,000 and place a 30-day sandbox flag in our vendor system. If spend approaches the cap we will require a PO or a prepay.

3) Approval ladder: This temporary waiver can be approved by Procurement + Revenue Ops for pilots under $5k. Anything above requires Procurement director sign-off. Karthik, please confirm we can accept the signed MOU + evidence pack as sufficient contractual cover for a 30-day waiver.

If that works, Priyom: I can create the temporary vendor entry and route the waiver approval today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@nimbleforge.io>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Marissa, thanks for the summary. A couple of legal/finance clarifications from my side:

- Contractual cover: The signed MOU we received is sufficient for a short pilot but please ensure the MOU includes the following clauses (if not present, add via cover email or an addendum): scope of pilot, payment terms (net 30), liability cap (aligned with our standard), and data-processing assurances (if any customer data will be processed).
- Evidence: W-9 required for US legal entity. Insurance proof should name Redwood Inference as an additional insured where feasible.
- Accounting treatment: Finance will treat the pilot as regular AP spend; ledger coding will require an interim GL account we use for pilots — Marissa, please set the GL to 6-12-340 until a PO is created.

If Marissa confirms the evidence and that the exposure stays <= $5k, Legal/Finance sign-off is given for the 30-day invoice-only onboarding. Priyom: please confirm the expected pilot spend and schedule. Elena: please send the missing W-9 and confirm invoice remit details.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial & Finance

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@nimbleforge.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice-only (no PO)

Thanks everyone — sending the W-9 and insurance summary now (attached).

Pilot estimate: $3,200 total (two-week integration + usage) — we will issue a single invoice on completion with net-30 payment terms. AP remit: invoices@nimbleforge.io, ACH to bank acct ending 2241 (full details in the attached evidence pack).

We accept the 30-day sandbox flag and $5k cap. Please let me know when the temporary vendor entry is live and we have the waiver approved so we can begin integration on Monday.

Best regards,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Operations | NimbleForge
Attachments: nimbleforge-w9.pdf, nimbleforge-insurance-summary.pdf
